elevate.definition:
v give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
v raise from a lower to a higher position
v raise in rank or condition
elevate.translation: vt. 举起, 提拔, 鼓舞

elevated tank.translation: [化] 高架储罐; 高位槽

elevates.definition:
v give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
v raise from a lower to a higher position
v raise in rank or condition
elevates.translation: v. 举起( elevate的第三人称单数 ); 提高; 提升; 鼓舞

elevating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Elevate
elevating.translation: v. 举起( elevate的现在分词 ); 提高; 提升; 鼓舞

elevation.definition:
n. the event of something being raised upward
n. angular distance above the horizon (especially of a celestial object)
n. distance of something above a reference point (such as sea level)
elevation.translation:
n. 海拔, 提高, 仰角
[计] 仰角

elevations.definition:
n. the event of something being raised upward
n. the highest level or degree attainable; the highest stage of development
n. angular distance above the horizon (especially of a celestial object)
elevations.translation: n. （水平或数量）提高( elevation的复数形式 ); 高地; 海拔; 提升

elevator.definition:
n. lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building
n. the airfoil on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes it ascend or descend
elevator.translation:
n. 电梯, 升降机
[化] 提升机

elevator circles.definition:
Walking awkwardly around a large elevator lobby after you press the button, because you don't know which elevator door to stand by.
> At work yesterday, my boss walked by while I was doing my elevator circles, and now he thinks I'm crazy.

elevator man.translation:
na. 开电梯的人
[网络] 电梯人

elevator music.translation: 电梯音乐（电梯里单调的轻音乐）

elevators.definition:
n. lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building
n. the airfoil on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes it ascend or descend
elevators.translation: n. 电梯( elevator的复数形式 ); 升降机（美）; 谷仓; 粮仓

elevatory.definition:
a. Tending to raise, or having power to elevate; as,
   elevatory forces.
n. See Elevator, n. (e).
elevatory.translation: a. 提升的, 升高的

eleven.definition:
n. the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one
s. being one more than ten

eleven-plus.definition: n. (formerly in Britain) an examination taken by 11 and 12 year old students to select suitable candidates for grammar school

elevenfold.translation:
a. 十一倍的
adv. 十一倍地

elevens.definition:
n the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one
n a team that plays football
elevens.translation: n. 上午11点左右的点心

elevenses.definition:
n the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one
n a team that plays football
elevenses.translation: n. 午前茶, 午前茶点

eleventh.definition:
n. position 11 in a countable series of things
s. coming next after the tenth and just before the twelfth in position
eleventh.translation: num. 第十一, 十一分之一

eleventh hour.translation: n. 最后一刻, 危急之时

eleventh nerve.translation: [医] 第十一脑神经, 副神经

elevenths.definition: n. position 11 in a countable series of things
elevenths.translation: n. 第十一( eleventh的复数形式 ); 最后关头, 最后一刻

eleventy.definition:
originally derived from Tolkien's Lord of the Rings trilogy.  Bilbo Baggin's eleventy-first birth day was the setting of the opening chapter.  Since used by people all over the world.
> Bilbo reached the ripe old age of eleventy-one.
